Гиалуроновая кислота.about: Polysaccharide of joints and skin; works in the form of injections for arthrosis, there is no data available orally.
Гиалуроновая кислота.caution: Intra-articular injections for knee OA: SMALL effect, and PRP (plasma) is SUPERIOR to HA (LP-PRP MD -10.54 WOMAC). Oral (DS): high-quality RCT with NO outcomes. Cosmetic fillers: rare severe vascular complications (necrosis, loss of vision).
Гиалуроновая кислота.food_sources: You can’t get it from food: there are no working doses of HA in foods; in chicken broth and cartilage the quantities are negligible.
Гиалуроновая кислота.guidelines: Cochrane 2015: HA injections are of little help for ankle arthrosis. MA 2026: PRP is more effective than HA. No oral data available.
Гиалуроновая кислота.how_to_choose: The oral form does not make sense (no data); injections - discuss with your doctor, PRP is more effective according to WOMAC.

Гиалуроновая кислота.myths: “We drink and the joints are lubricated” - RCT does not show any benefit orally. “Better than plasma” - no: PRP is superior to HA according to WOMAC (MA 2026).
Гиалуроновая кислота.name: Hyaluronic Acid
Гиалуроновая кислота.onset: Injections: effect on pain is visible for months (6 months, −12% AOS); Dietary supplement - no effect shown.
Гиалуроновая кислота.title: Hyaluronic Acid
Гиалуроновая кислота.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Гиалуроновая кислота.who_needs: Arthrosis of the knee/ankle (injections); the oral form is only hope for the skin, there is no benefit in RCT.
